strategy.summary: The static todo app (public/app.js) already implements completing, filtering and clearing todos in-browser with in-memory state. Playwright e2e tests must prove that ticking/unticking toggles strike-through and the "items left" count, that All/Active/Completed filters show the right todos and mark the selected one pressed (aria-pressed), and that "Clear completed" is shown only while a todo is completed and removes every completed todo.
inScope: Completing and un-completing a todo via its checkbox (strike-through, items-left count)
All / Active / Completed filters and their pressed state
outOfScope: Adding todos (covered by tests/add-todo.spec.js; used only as setup)
Persistence across reloads (the app keeps state in memory only; ticket doesn't ask for it)
assumptions: The real app runs: there is no API, todos live in page memory, so nothing is faked; each test gets fresh state from its own page and adds its own todos through the UI.
The app is served by the existing playwright.config.js webServer (node server.js on 4173, which run_tests' BASE_URL also targets); the config is left unchanged.
'Struck through' is asserted as the todo text's computed text-decoration-line being 'line-through' (the user-visible effect of styles.css), located by role/text, never by CSS class.
'Shown as pressed' means aria-pressed="true" on the selected filter button and "false" on the others, as app.js sets it.
The app has no refusals for these actions; the negative case is that Clear completed is not offered while nothing is completed.

risks.description: Count not updated or updated by the wrong amount on toggle
risks.mitigation: TC1/TC2 assert the exact count text before and after with three todos

risks.description: Filter shows wrong subset or pressed state out of sync
risks.mitigation: TC3-TC5 assert exact list contents and aria-pressed on all three buttons

risks.description: Clear completed removes active todos or only some completed ones
risks.mitigation: TC7 uses two completed and one active todo and asserts the exact remaining list

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ticking a todo's checkbox marks it completed: it is struck through and the items-left count goes down by one; unticking reverses both.
Active shows only not-completed todos, Completed only completed ones, All every todo; the selected filter is shown as pressed.
"Clear completed" appears only while at least one todo is completed, and removes every completed todo.

testCases.title: ticking a todo strikes it through and decreases the items left count
steps: Assert '3 items left' and 'Walk dog' not struck through
testCases.expected: Checkbox checked, 'Walk dog' text has line-through, others don't, count reads '2 items left'

testCases.title: unticking a completed todo removes the strike-through and restores the items left count
steps: Tick 'Walk dog' and see '2 items left'
testCases.expected: Checkbox unchecked, no line-through, count reads '3 items left'

testCases.title: Active filter shows only todos that are not completed and is shown as pressed
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Buy milk', 'Pay rent']; Active aria-pressed=true, All and Completed false

testCases.title: Completed filter shows only completed todos and is shown as pressed
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Walk dog']; Completed aria-pressed=true, others false

testCases.title: All filter shows every todo and is shown as pressed after switching back
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent']; All aria-pressed=true, others false

testCases.title: Clear completed is hidden while no todo is completed
steps: Add two todos; wait for both in the list; assert Clear completed is hidden
Tick one; assert Clear completed is visible
testCases.expected: Clear completed button hidden with no completed todos, visible while one is, hidden again after unticking
testCases.rationale: The 'appears only while' half of AC3

testCases.title: Clear completed removes every completed todo and keeps active ones
testCases.expected: List is exactly ['Walk dog'], count '1 item left', Clear completed hidden
testCases.rationale: Removal of all (not just one) completed todos without touching active ones

strategy.environmentNotes: No services beyond the static server started by playwright.config.js webServer (node server.js, port 4173). Chromium via Playwright.
